subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Populous
solution:
The correct answer is Crowded.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word 'populous' means having a large population; densely populated.
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• ​Crowded- Full of people, leaving little or no room for movement; packed.
 
• Inactive- Not engaging in or involving any or much physical activity.
 
• Sleepy- Needing or ready for sleep.
 
• Sleepless- Characterized by or experiencing lack of sleep.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate synonym of the given word 'populous' is 'crowded'.
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.
